run.subject: Which payments between 1 January 2024 and 30 October 2026 cross a jurisdictional boundary?
run.final_text:
{"status": "answered", "answer": "Treasury records eight payments between 1 January 2024 and 30 October 2026. A payment crosses a border when payer and payee have different recorded tax residences on the payment date.

**Cross-border (3):**
- P-001, 15 March 2024: capital call of USD 5,000,000 from Harbor Pension Trust (LU) to Atlas Growth Fund I LP (US).
- P-005, 18 September 2026: dividend of EUR 3,000,000 from Borealis Logistik GmbH (DE) to Atlas Borealis Holdco Sarl (LU).
- P-006, 25 September 2026: dividend of EUR 3,000,000 from Atlas Borealis Holdco Sarl (LU) to Atlas Growth Fund I LP (US).

**Not cross-border (3), all US to US:**
- P-003, 18 March 2024: capital call of USD 1,500,000 from Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle LP to Atlas Growth Fund I LP.
- P-007, 9 October 2026: dividend of USD 10,000,000 from Orion Manufacturing Inc to Atlas Acquisition SPV LLC.
- P-008, 12 October 2026: dividend of USD 10,000,000 from Atlas Acquisition SPV LLC to Atlas Growth Fund I LP.

**Undetermined (2):**
- P-002, 18 March 2024: capital call of USD 12,000,000 from Atlas Lux Feeder SCSp to Atlas Growth Fund I LP (US). The payer's tax residence is not recorded; its incorporation in LU is recorded but does not decide the crossing.
- P-004, 1 July 2026: management fee of USD 1,000,000 from Atlas Growth Fund I LP (US) to Atlas Capital Management LLC. The payee matches no structure entity or investor, so it has no recorded residence.

Three cautions apply:
- P-007 and P-008 carry value dates after today (8 October 2026), so they are treasury records of payments that have not yet occurred.
- The comparison is at country level, so a boundary between sub-national jurisdictions (for example US states) is not tested.
- The computation is marked draft in the bundle.", "facts": [{"subject": "P-001", "attribute": "crossing", "value": "crossBorder", "source_ref": "treasury.payment:P-001"}, {"subject": "P-002", "attribute": "crossing", "value": "undetermined", "source_ref": "treasury.payment:P-002"}, {"subject": "P-003", "attribute": "crossing", "value": "notCrossBorder", "source_ref": "treasury.payment:P-003"}, {"subject": "P-004", "attribute": "crossing", "value": "undetermined", "source_ref": "treasury.payment:P-004"}, {"subject": "P-005", "attribute": "crossing", "value": "crossBorder", "source_ref": "treasury.payment:P-005"}, {"subject": "P-006", "attribute": "crossing", "value": "crossBorder", "source_ref": "treasury.payment:P-006"}, {"subject": "P-007", "attribute": "crossing", "value": "notCrossBorder", "source_ref": "treasury.payment:P-007"}, {"subject": "P-008", "attribute": "crossing", "value": "notCrossBorder", "source_ref": "treasury.payment:P-008"}], "unknown": ["P-002: the tax residence of the payer, Atlas Lux Feeder SCSp, is not recorded in entity management on 18 March 2024 (only its incorporation in LU is), so whether the payment crosses a border is unknown.", "P-004: the payee, Atlas Capital Management LLC, matches no structure entity or investor by LEI, so neither its tax residence nor its incorporation is recorded and whether the payment crosses a border is unknown.", "Whether any payment crosses a sub-national boundary (for example between US states) is not tested; the computation compares tax residence by country only.", "P-007 and P-008 have value dates (9 and 12 October 2026) after today, 8 October 2026; their classification rests on the tax residences currently recorded for those dates."], "conflicts": []}

result.label: Jurisdiction
result.definition: A territory with its own legal or tax authority, national or sub-national.

result.label: Jurisdiction Fact
result.definition: A dated statement linking a legal entity to a jurisdiction in a stated capacity, such as incorporation, tax residence or operating location.

result.label: Jurisdiction Fact Type
result.definition: The capacity in which an entity is linked to a jurisdiction.

result.label: Certification Type
result.definition: A kind of tax certification form. Members depend on the jurisdiction pair chosen and are supplied as data, not in this ontology.

result.label: Distribution Component
result.definition: The part of a distribution that has one income type and one source jurisdiction.

result.label: Rule Version
result.definition: One dated version of a rule that applies in a jurisdiction and states which facts it requires.

steps.executed:
WITH fact (cp_id, capacity, country, from_dt, to_dt, source_ref) AS (
    SELECT c.cp_id, j.capacity_cd, j.country, j.from_dt, j.to_dt,
           'entity_mgmt.entity_jurisdiction:' || j.entity_id || '/' || j.capacity_cd || '/' || j.country || '/' || j.from_dt
    FROM treasury.counterparty c
    JOIN entity_mgmt.legal_entity e ON e.lei = c.lei
    JOIN entity_mgmt.entity_jurisdiction j ON j.entity_id = e.entity_id AND j.capacity_cd IN ('TAXRES', 'INC')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.cp_id, 'TAXRES', r.country, r.from_dt, r.to_dt, 'onboarding.residence_record:' || r.inv_no || '/' || r.country || '/' || r.from_dt
    FROM treasury.counterparty c
    JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.lei = c.lei
    JOIN onboarding.residence_record r ON r.inv_no = i.inv_no
), matched (cp_id) AS (
    SELECT c.cp_id FROM treasury.counterparty c
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entity_mgmt.legal_entity e WHERE e.lei = c.lei)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM investor_register.investor i WHERE i.lei = c.lei)
), side AS (
    SELECT p.pay_id, s.role, cp.cp_id, cp.cp_name, m.cp_id IS NOT NULL AS matched,
           array_agg(DISTINCT f.country ORDER BY f.country) FILTER (WHERE f.capacity = 'TAXRES') AS residence,
           array_agg(DISTINCT f.country ORDER BY f.country) FILTER (WHERE f.capacity = 'INC') AS incorporation,
           array_agg(DISTINCT f.source_ref ORDER BY f.source_ref) FILTER (WHERE f.capacity = 'TAXRES') AS source_refs
    FROM treasury.payment p
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('payer'), ('payee')) AS s (role)
    JOIN treasury.counterparty cp ON cp.cp_id = CASE s.role WHEN 'payer' THEN p.payer_cp ELSE p.payee_cp END
    LEFT JOIN matched m ON m.cp_id = cp.cp_id
    LEFT JOIN fact f ON f.cp_id = cp.cp_id AND f.from_dt <= p.value_dt AND (f.to_dt IS NULL OR f.to_dt >= p.value_dt)
    GROUP BY p.pay_id, s.role, cp.cp_id, cp.cp_name, m.cp_id
)
SELECT p.pay_id AS payment, p.value_dt AS occurred_on, p.pay_type_cd AS payment_code, p.amt AS amount, p.ccy AS currency,
       a.cp_name AS payer_name, array_to_string(a.residence, ',') AS payer_tax_residence, array_to_string(a.incorporation, ',') AS payer_incorporation,
       b.cp_name AS payee_name, array_to_string(b.residence, ',') AS payee_tax_residence, array_to_string(b.incorporation, ',') AS payee_incorporation,
       CASE WHEN cardinality(a.residence) = 1 AND cardinality(b.residence) = 1
            THEN CASE WHEN a.residence = b.residence THEN 'notCrossBorder' ELSE 'crossBorder' END
            ELSE 'undetermined' END AS crossing,
       NULLIF(concat_ws('; ',
           CASE WHEN NOT a.matched THEN 'the payer matches no entity or investor'
                WHEN a.residence IS NULL THEN 'the tax residence of the payer is not recorded'
                WHEN cardinality(a.residence) > 1 THEN 'the sources give the payer more than one tax residence' END,
           CASE WHEN NOT b.matched THEN 'the payee matches no entity or investor'
                WHEN b.residence IS NULL THEN 'the tax residence of the payee is not recorded'
                WHEN cardinality(b.residence) > 1 THEN 'the sources give the payee more than one tax residence' END), '') AS reason,
       'treasury.payment:' || p.pay_id AS source_ref, a.source_refs || b.source_refs AS residence_refs
FROM treasury.payment p
JOIN side a ON a.pay_id = p.pay_id AND a.role = 'payer'
JOIN side b ON b.pay_id = p.pay_id AND b.role = 'payee'
WHERE p.value_dt BETWEEN %(from_date)s::date AND %(to_date)s::date
ORDER BY p.value_dt, p.pay_id
